patch_description: Restore a symmetry-aware, motif-aligned ansatz that previously achieved stronger performance: grouped RY input rotations by corner/edge/center, shared CRZ ring and center couplings, ZZZ three-qubit rotations aligned with the eight winning lines, compact CCRZ high-order correlations, and shared final RX+RZ rotations per symmetry orbit. This recovers the winning-line motif priors (explicit 3-qubit ZZZ interactions) while keeping parameter sharing efficient (13 keys per block → 78 total parameters), increasing expressive power targeted at tic-tac-toe structure and improving accuracy and generalization without changing the training loop or feature map.
